text: Sophocles' play Oedipus the King remembers the riddling Sphinx, but it never gives the words of the riddle. Later writers do: what has one voice, and becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed? A human being. In these texts, there is no morning, noon, or evening.
spoken_text: Sophocles' play Oedipus the King remembers the riddling Sphinx, but it never gives the words of the riddle. Later writers do: what has one voice, and becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed? A human being. In these texts, there is no morning, noon, or evening.
